claim_groups.paper_text: Reliable execution connects plans to physical action; Evidence-grounded PID and Fuzzy-PID evaluation for a 2-link manipulator.

claim_groups.paper_text: Nominal success is not enough; controlled payload/configuration/noise/disturbance/actuator stress is needed; failed completed runs are retained; conclusions are simulation-only.
claim_groups.evidence: Raw deterministic/stochastic/Cartesian CSVs contain completed failed rows and the listed stress categories; evidence set contains simulation artifacts only and no hardware validation.

claim_groups.paper_text: 0.001 s fixed sample time, 5.0 s nominal duration, 5001 samples per nominal run, and identical plant/protocol controls.
claim_groups.evidence: Nominal MAT reference/options recompute sampleTime=0.001, duration=5.0, samples=5001; raw rows show paired seeds and shared controller-scenario protocol.

claim_groups.paper_text: The bounded search reduces the nominal objective by 7.283% and improves held-out payload objective from 0.214504 to 0.197284; exit flag 1, 12 iterations, 96 evaluations.
claim_groups.evidence: pid_optimization.mat recomputes 7.283147860458988%, 0.21450363216387297 to 0.19728400491642561, exitFlag=1, iterations=12, funcCount=96; non-gain controller fields match.

claim_groups.paper_text: Success rises from 8/13 to 9/13 to 10/13; matrix contains 39 runs across seven deterministic categories; all three controllers fail the combined case.
claim_groups.evidence: deterministic_robustness_runs.csv and summary CSV recompute 39 rows, 13 scenarios per controller, success counts 8/9/10, and three completed failures for combined-deterministic.

claim_groups.paper_text: Each isolated-noise cell passes 30/30 paired trials; every combined-stress cell passes 0/30; study has 360 trials; high-noise optimized PID has lowest tracking error and highest mean torque slew of 2888.34 N m/s.
claim_groups.evidence: stochastic_robustness_summary.csv and trials CSV recompute 9 isolated 30/30 cells, 3 combined 0/30 cells, 4 scenarios x 3 controllers x 30 paired seeds, and optimized high-noise mean torque slew 2888.34441441764.

claim_groups.paper_text: All 3 controllers pass straight-line; only optimized PID passes pick-transfer-place; 4 of 6 completed task runs pass; optimized PID has 0.01422 m RMS and 0.02970 m maximum Cartesian error.
claim_groups.evidence: cartesian_tasks_runs.csv recomputes six completed runs, four successes, only optimization-pid successful on pick-transfer-place, CartesianRms=0.0142210111046117, CartesianMax=0.029698222399069.

claim_groups.paper_text: Simulink and Multibody each pass 2/2 agreement/tracking checks; worst end-effector difference is 3.34e-16 m; result supports fixed-protocol model consistency, not hardware fidelity.
claim_groups.evidence: simulink_cross_validation_runs.csv and multibody_cross_validation_runs.csv recompute 2/2 agreement and tracking passes for each formulation; worst Multibody EndEffectorMax=3.34221388864417e-16 m; MaximumOutOfPlane=0.

claim_groups.paper_text: Optimized PID is the strongest reliability baseline: 8/13 manual, 9/13 Fuzzy-PID, 10/13 optimized; nominal metrics are mixed, and optimized PID has deterministic/Cartesian reliability with torque-slew trade-off.
claim_groups.evidence: Deterministic CSVs recompute 8/13, 9/13, 10/13; Cartesian CSV shows optimized is the only pick-transfer-place success; stochastic high-noise summary shows optimized lowest MeanJointRms and highest MeanTorqueSlew; nominal MAT shows mixed manual/Fuzzy steady RMS by joint.

claim_groups.paper_text: Next steps are hardware-in-the-loop/physical validation, perception/task-planning integration, online monitoring, collision avoidance, and safety supervision before deployment.
claim_groups.evidence: The claim is prospective and scoped as not-yet-claimed validation/safety/perception work.
